title: 3 tier ceramic service
text: 3 tier ceramic service. The plates are ceramic.  Comes with silver metal (very, very lightweight) hardware including washers for in between plates as you assemble.  The outer box is pretty.  Great for gift giving - so I purchased the two I needed to serve tea treats at a shower and one as a gift for the bride because the box looked like such a pretty gift.  I proceeded to unpack my servers and was immediately hit with a horrible, musty, overwhelming smell...probably due to the tremendous amount of Styrofoam packing - Styrofoam is great for holding awful smells.  A real mess  - no to mention the mess it creates when you unpack it... it breaks and floats everywhere... To be fair, careful packing was necessary to protect the ceramic plates, but Styrofoam is so awful to get rid of in an environmentally positive way.  Further,  the bride I had planned on gifting a set to,  is a VERY earth conscientious person. So now I am torn.  I am thinking of making an additional purchase of a really nice storing box and cushioning felts for in between each plate - opening her set and giving it to her open, but clean, not smelly (was better after dishwasher) set. *PS - I DID make the additional purchase* The ceramic plates are close to the measurements given.  There are pierced holes in the design of each plate in case that matters to you.  They are also look "embossed" with a lacy like print that you can feel, so the plates are not perfectly smooth.  The edges are scalloped.  The bottoms of the plates is smooth and not embossed.  The plates are warm white in color.  It is going to use for my purpose, but I wish we could have packing that would be WAY more earth friendly.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: BonNoces 3-Tier Porcelain Cupcake Stand Serving Tray - White Embossed Elegant Dessert Cake Stand - Pastry Serving Stand for Tea Party, Wedding and Birthday
features: Pure white porcelain relief design cake stand, with a delicate sturdy silver stents, can show your carefully prepared dessert snacks and cakes, also an attractive ornament on the table. Unique and exquisitely built, quality and sense of art coexist, brings elegance and beauty to you.

The dessert stand is made of high-quality sturdy porcelain, it is food safe and lead free. And the diameter of platters: 6'', 8'', 10''. Tall 14.5". Smooth glaze surface easy to clean, simple assembly and disassemble.

The 3-tier of design serving tray, not only can save space, put more snack desserts, but also make your table clean and tidy. And the unique silver ring bracket design shows charm, which can be carried and moved more conveniently.

Delicate embossing decorative pattern and crafted wavy flower edge tiered dessert stand, it's a great way to display cupcakes, appetizers, fruit, brownies, desserts, perfect for tea party, wedding, baby showers, Christmas or for home decor.

Beautiful and elegant cupcake stand, combining with elegant decorative style, give you a sensory experience that you never had. Each ceramic cake rack is equipped with a beautiful gift box which is a best gift for your family and friends.
